string-array.name: power_steps_xiaomi
string-array.item: Open Autostart and switch GeekBridge on.
Open Settings › Apps › GeekBridge › Battery saver and choose “No restrictions”.
In Recent apps, pull the GeekBridge card down (or tap its lock) so it is not swiped away.

string-array.name: power_steps_samsung
string-array.item: Open Settings › Apps › GeekBridge › Battery and choose “Unrestricted”.

In Settings › Battery (“Battery and device care” on older One UI) › Background usage limits, open “Never sleeping apps”, tap + and add GeekBridge. Also remove it from “Sleeping apps” and “Deep sleeping apps”.
On the same page switch off “Put unused apps to sleep” (and “Auto-disable unused apps” if it is shown).
If it still disconnects, switch off “Adaptive battery” (Settings › Battery › More battery settings).

string-array.name: power_steps_huawei
string-array.item: Open App launch (Settings › Battery › App launch), set GeekBridge to “Manage manually”.
Switch on Auto-launch, Secondary launch and Run in background.

string-array.name: power_steps_oneplus
string-array.item: Open Settings › Battery › Battery optimisation, find GeekBridge and choose “Don’t optimise”.
In Settings › Apps › GeekBridge › Battery usage, allow background activity and auto-launch.
In Recent apps, lock GeekBridge so it is not cleared.

string-array.name: power_steps_oppo
string-array.item: Open Auto-launch / Startup manager and switch GeekBridge on.
In Settings › Battery › GeekBridge, allow background activity.
In Recent apps, lock GeekBridge so it is not cleared.

string-array.name: power_steps_vivo
string-array.item: Open Autostart / Background start-up manager and allow GeekBridge.
In Settings › Battery › Background power consumption, set GeekBridge to “Allow high background power consumption”.

string-array.name: power_steps_pixel
string-array.item: Open Settings › Apps › GeekBridge › App battery usage and choose “Unrestricted”. “Optimized” can still pause the link when the phone sits idle, and “Restricted” stops it.
If it still disconnects, switch off “Adaptive battery” (Settings › Battery › Adaptive preferences).

string-array.name: power_steps_nothing
string-array.item: Open Settings › Apps › GeekBridge › App battery usage and choose “Unrestricted”.
Nothing OS has no separate autostart list. If it still disconnects, check that Settings › Battery › Battery optimisation does not list GeekBridge as “Optimised”.
